It added the [[Pursuit]] rework and {{Color|Other|Plushie}} [[Pyromancer]] skin. This update encompassed seven updates, the main v1.43.0 update (released 27 November 2024) and six minor updates, v1.43.1 (released 27 November 2024), v1.43.1a (released 29 November 2024), v1.43.2 (released 29 November 2024), v1.43.2a (released 30 November 2024), v1.43.2b (released 2 December 2024) and v1.43.3 (released 3 December 2024). ==Additions== ===Skins=== *{{Color|Other|Plushie}}
